title: Installation of a Flap Track Carriage Roller Assembly
abstract: Installation of a flap track carriage roller assembly, including the shim setting that controls the roller clearance and the full flap travel test that closes the task out.

sections.purpose: This task gives the procedure to install one roller assembly on a flap track carriage and to set the roller clearance to the track.
sections.job_setup_note: The raceway and the track surface must be clean and free of any recorded finding. Reuse the shim stack that came off the same position unless the roller clearance measurement says otherwise; a new roller on an old shim stack will usually need one shim less. Keep the relief jack loaded until the retaining nut is torqued. The flap travel test at the end of the task needs the flap system energised and a second person at the flight deck.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the raceway and the track surface are clean and that no open finding is recorded. 2. Confirm that the relief jack is still loaded under the carriage. 3. Pack the bearing with the approved grease and fit the seal to the roller. 4. Put the roller assembly in the carriage and align it with the pin bore. 5. Install the shim stack in the order recorded at removal. 6. Install the roller pin and the retaining nut finger tight. 7. Measure the roller clearance to the track with the feeler gauge. CAUTION: DO NOT SET THE ROLLER CLEARANCE OUTSIDE THE RANGE IN THE ILLUSTRATION. A TIGHT ROLLER WILL OVERHEAT AND A SLACK ROLLER WILL LET THE CARRIAGE RATTLE. 8. Adjust the shim stack until the clearance is correct. 9. Torque the retaining nut and fit the lockwire. 10. Install the drain filter D2750139843846 and re-shim the heat exchanger BEDE63136-96 mounting to restore the drain slope. 11. Unload and remove the relief jack. 12. Energise the flap system and do a full flap travel test. WARNING: KEEP CLEAR OF THE FLAP TRACK AND THE CARRIAGE DURING THE TRAVEL TEST. 13. Check that the regulator 5CE and the track valve 9KS3 give the correct indication.
sections.close_out: Remove the warning notices from the flap control panel. Record the shim stack, the measured roller clearance and the travel test result on the aircraft work card. Do a general visual inspection of the flap track fairing and confirm that it is correctly closed. Report any abnormal noise heard during the travel test.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. Post MOD-162744 aircraft use the double-lip seal and the chloride-resistant grease; the clearance range is unchanged.

safety_precautions: Keep the relief jack loaded until the retaining nut is torqued.
Keep clear of the flap track during the travel test.
Put the warning notices in position at the flap control panel.
